amenitiesDescription:
The Fisher Island Club Access

Ownership includes privileged access to the Fisher Island Club amenities. Residents benefit from the Beach Club's imported Bahamian white sand, the historic Vanderbilt Mansion, the 24,000-square-foot Spa Internazionale, a championship golf course, racquet facilities, and deep-water marinas capable of accommodating vessels up to 250 feet.

investmentThesis: As of June 2026, three of six estates are under contract, representing more than $105 million in consolidated transaction volume, with three homes still available in a collection priced from $32 million to $55 million. The Mansions on Fisher Island addresses a format gap on the island: ground-up single-family estates distinct from the condominium inventory at Six Fisher Island and prior deliveries. Fisher Island's ferry-only access and consistently top-tier household wealth profile support long-duration demand for estate-scale product with club infrastructure attached. MADAR Group USA and ASR Construction bring a dedicated estate delivery model; Portuondo Perotti, Enzo Enea, and Ford Interiors align the offering with buyers who expect architectural and landscape pedigree at this price point. Construction is underway, with completions phased from late 2026 through the second quarter of 2027.

residenceContent:
The Mansions on Fisher Island is a limited collection of ground-up, single-family estates on America's most exclusive private island.

An Unprecedented Acquisition Opportunity

Positioned on America's most exclusive private island, The Mansions on Fisher Island represents a rare offering within Miami's ultra-prime market. This limited collection of ground-up, single-family estates combines the scale and autonomy of traditional residential living with the elite, world-class infrastructure of the Fisher Island Club. Accessible solely by auto-ferry, helicopter, or private yacht, the 216-acre enclave provides absolute security and seclusion for the global elite.

Market Positioning & Constrained Inventory

The ultra-prime sector of Miami-Dade real estate operates distinctly from broader macroeconomic trends, driven by sustained wealth migration and an absolute scarcity of waterfront single-family assets. The Mansions on Fisher Island recently placed three of its six estates under contract prior to completion—reflecting sustained demand for ground-up architectural pedigree on an island where new inventory is structurally limited.

Single-family homes have always been a rarity on the 216-acre island, and the three remaining estates—reaching approximately 18,000 interior square feet, the largest single-family residence ever built on Fisher Island—represent one of the last opportunities to secure new-construction, estate-scale living in one of America's most exclusive private-island enclaves.

Architectural Pedigree & Design

Conceived by Portuondo Perotti Architects and developed by MADAR Group USA in collaboration with ASR Construction, the estates are a study in Mediterranean grandeur and contemporary refinement. Each residence features a Tuscan-inspired facade, soaring ceiling heights, and expansive floor-to-ceiling window systems that optimize natural light. Interior spaces, styled by Ford Interiors, utilize hand-selected stone surfaces from top global quarries, custom European cabinetry, and uncompromised finishes throughout.
